title: Score Chord Payload
description: Score control events with DLC event value 'Chord', one row per event. Columns are parallel arrays. DLC quarterbeats, quarterbeats_all_endings, duration_qb and duration are represented by the quarters_interval.fraction extent. mc_onset, mn_onset and timesig are omitted as derivable from the measures facet; event is derived from payload_type.

mc.description: Measure counts: 1-based index of the measure unit in the encoded score (ms3 'mc').

mn.description: Measure numbers as printed in the score (ms3 'mn'; 0 for an anacrusis).

volta.description: Volta (ending) number of the measure containing the event; null outside voltas.

slur.description: ms3 identifiers of slurs active at the event, e.g. '0' or '92, 93'; null when absent.

crescendo_hairpin.description: ms3 identifiers of crescendo hairpins active at the event, e.g. '0' or '92, 93'; null when absent.

decrescendo_hairpin.description: ms3 identifiers of decrescendo hairpins active at the event, e.g. '0' or '92, 93'; null when absent.

crescendo_line.description: ms3 identifiers of crescendo lines active at the event, e.g. '0' or '92, 93'; null when absent.

diminuendo_line.description: ms3 identifiers of diminuendo lines active at the event, e.g. '0' or '92, 93'; null when absent.

pedal.description: ms3 identifiers of pedal spanners active at the event, e.g. '0' or '92, 93'; null when absent.

chord_id.description: Identifier of the chord (stem), unique within the piece.

nominal_duration.description: Notated durations as fractions of a whole note before dots and tuplets are applied (e.g. [1, 4] for a quarter note).

scalar.description: Factors that dots and tuplets apply to nominal_duration (e.g. [3, 2] for a dotted note, [2, 3] inside a triplet).

gracenote.description: Grace note type of the chord (e.g. 'acciaccatura', 'appoggiatura', 'grace16'); null for regular chords.

articulation.description: Articulation markings attached to the chord as encoded by ms3; null when absent.

tremolo.description: Tremolo specification as encoded by the source (e.g. '1/2_r16_0'); null when absent.

lyrics_1.description: Lyric text attached to the chord in verse 1; null when absent.

lyrics_2.description: Lyric text attached to the chord in verse 2; null when absent.

lyrics_3.description: Lyric text attached to the chord in verse 3; null when absent.
